datasets.name: C-NMC 2019
datasets.mirror_license_note: Mirror says Other / license unspecified; retain primary TCIA attribution and record discrepancy.
datasets.citation: Mourya, S., Kant, S., Kumar, P., Gupta, A., & Gupta, R. (2019). ALL Challenge dataset of ISBI 2019 (C-NMC 2019), Version 1. The Cancer Imaging Archive. DOI: 10.7937/tcia.2019.dc64i46r
datasets.selected_partition: training_data only: fold_0 train, fold_1 validation, fold_2 internal held-out test
datasets.patient_ids: parse UID_<subject>_<image>_<cell>_<class>.bmp; namespace subject by class
datasets.excluded: All preliminary/final challenge test partitions; final test does not provide usable public ground truth for this protocol.
limitations: Cell crops, no original smear-image detection ground truth
Binary endpoint covers B-ALL blasts rather than all blood cancers

datasets.name: AML-Cytomorphology_LMU
datasets.mirror_license_note: Kaggle mirror says Unknown. Primary dataset license and citations retained. JPEG conversion is a derivative; do not claim pixel identity with original TIFF.
datasets.citation: Matek, C., Schwarz, S., Marr, C., & Spiekermann, K. (2019). A Single-cell Morphological Dataset of Leukocytes from AML Patients and Non-malignant Controls. TCIA. DOI: 10.7937/tcia.2019.36f5o9ld
datasets.selected_partition: LYT typical lymphocytes and MYO myeloblasts only; all retained selected cells external_test
datasets.patient_ids: Not recoverable from randomized class-specific filenames; never treat cell counters as patient IDs.
limitations: Simultaneous source, disease-lineage and negative-class maturity shift: B-ALL vs benign precursors -> AML myeloblasts vs typical lymphocytes; not matched B-ALL external validation
No patient diagnosis inferred from individual morphology; normal morphology does not mean healthy donor
No patient-level confidence interval without mapping
Mirror JPEG conversion introduces additional compression/domain shift; not the canonical TIFF benchmark
Excluded all other morphological classes, rather than automatically labeling every immature cell malignant
datasets.label_definition_source: https://github.com/marrlab/DinoBloom (AML Matek: MYO Myeloblast, MYB Myelocyte, LYT Lymphocyte typical)

datasets.name: BCCD Blood Cell Count and Detection
datasets.license: MIT per upstream repository; preserve upstream LICENSE
datasets.selected_annotations: WBC boxes only; RBC and Platelets are background for this one-class task
datasets.patient_ids: Not provided; upstream image-level splits only
limitations: Cannot measure end-to-end malignant-cell detection mAP from these labels

considered_not_selected.name: ALL-IDB
considered_not_selected.reason: Requires signed application and email access; no unauthorized mirror used. ALL-IDB1 supplies centroids rather than complete WBC bounding boxes; ALL-IDB2 crops overlap with ALL-IDB1.

considered_not_selected.name: Raabin-WBC
considered_not_selected.reason: Possible future larger WBC localization source; BCCD chosen now for small reproducible detection baseline, without adding a second unrelated label ontology.

considered_not_selected.name: Taleqani ALL
considered_not_selected.reason: Downloaded and visually inspected. Original and Segmented fields contain multiple cells; image labels cannot be assigned to every detected cell. Excluded from primary single-cell protocol. Could support a separately specified weakly supervised image-level task.
